title: CAPTAIN'S LOGBOOK
content:
Welcome to the Captain's Log / Sketch Repository.
This is where I keep my daily creative musings and sketches.
In here, you will see the 'Captain' working strictly as a creator—this is a record of the very moments when stories come to life.

欢迎来到船长的日志/速写存放处。
这里主要存放平时的创作随想以及灵感草图。
在这里,你将看到完全作为创作者而工作的船长——记录着那些故事诞生的瞬间。
